outcome: Cesarean section rate due to fetal distress
cohort: The study included 100 women at term who were in labor with meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
finding: Intrapartum amnioinfusion in women with meconium-stained liquor significantly improved neonatal outcome and reduced the cesarean section rate due to fetal distress without increasing maternal or fetal complications.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate due to fetal distress was significantly lower in the amnioinfusion group (20.0%) compared to the control group (40.0%).
